skill.summary: Generate customer-facing answers for common real estate questions. Use when working on FAQ content for real estate teams, brokers, listing marketers.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Build Real Estate FAQ Page skill.

- Generates customer-facing answers for common real estate questions.
- Designed for FAQ content creation by real estate teams, brokers, and listing marketers.
- Integrates with chat and web search APIs for enriched, relevant answers.
- Includes SEO-focused metadata and recommended keywords for targeting search intent.
- Offers a clear workflow for drafting, refining, and reviewing FAQ content.
